scope: Document assessment; not practitioner utility or certified historical backtest
analyst_boundary: Fresh context; input-only folder; no network or other repository reads. Instruction boundary, not OS sandbox. Model prior knowledge cannot be excluded.

criteria.requirement: Expose 2519 versus 2509 contradiction; use corroboration without claiming title verification
Separate 2017 parkland authorization from remaining disposition and land-use approvals
Expose terrain/rock/no survey; public contours cannot prove buildable envelope
Identify R7-1/AIRS and qualification uncertainty without invented FAR or units
Separate 4% and 9% branches; cite subsidy caps and financing evidence; no award guarantee
Account for nonresidential income/equity support; no free amenities
Use threshold/competitive feasibility and capacity obligations; no unit maximization
Resolve clarifications and latest team/form requirements
Separate agency facts, assumptions, inference, missing evidence; no fabricated professional acceptance
Specify evidence and responsible roles for next decision, with bounded recommendations

grading: met / partial / missed / contradicted with evidence, no aggregate score. Source page review and citations audited separately. No outcome unit-count score. No threshold changes after output.
reveal_condition: Assessment files and input/rubric hashes frozen in Git before evaluator reads later reference in this run. Curator previously exposed; disclose.
